svg.text: EPLB in DeepInfer: count, rearrange, move the weights
ExpertLoadBalancer in model_executor/eplb/ · one object per group of MoE layers with the same layout · commit 9bd9cf2
What does EPLB count in each step?
The MoE kernels add the tokens that each local expert slot receives. One call per step reads and clears the counts.
a. copy counts into window W
First after N // 4 counted steps (at least 1), then every N counted steps. Example: N = 30.
Start value: N - max(1, N // 4) = 23 (eplb/__init__.py:122-123). Each counted step adds 1; at N it rearranges and starts at 0.
NORMAL engine, after-prefill flag off: prefill steps do not count. Flag on (example scripts): the next decode step
after a prefill step rearranges at once (eplb/__init__.py:83-84, 149-159). EP size 1: step() returns at once.
How do the expert weights move?
Only slots whose expert changes get new weights. Example from the policy diagram: 3 experts move.
Rank 1 fills e0, e4 and e1 from its own old slots: local copies, no traffic (shuffle.py:16-25).
GPU, EP group in one NVLink domain:
symm_mem mirror of one layer; each rank reads the peer mirror directly (shuffle.py:178-218)
batch_isend_irecv (NCCL or HCCL) in DEEPINFER_REARRANGE_P2P_GROUPS buckets (shuffle.py:94-147)
Weights per layer: gate_up and down, plus their scales for fp8/fp4 weights; dim 0 is the local slot (deepseek.py:324-329).
The doc values for production: prefill W = 100, N = 1000; decode W = 1000, N = 10000 (inference_deployment_qa.md:99, 103).
